create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Vancouver
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Vancouver, or AYV, grew out of the early-morning Mysore programme that Fiona Stang began in the city in 2000. She had first travelled to Mysore in 1999 to learn from the Jois family, was authorised to teach the following year, and started the programme with encouragement from the senior teacher Hamish Hendry, although even those closest to her doubted that dawn classes could work in a dark, rainy city. In 2009 she was one of the first forty students in the world to receive Level 2 authorisation, and her other teachers over the years include Tim Miller, David Swenson, John Scott and Sharmila Desai.

The shala's stated values are to honour the lineage, to treat every student as a person with their own needs, and to keep passing knowledge on. Mysore classes run from Monday to Thursday at 5:30 in the morning, both in the studio and online, while Friday brings an online counted full primary class with optional chanting beforehand. Newcomers are asked to begin with the school's introductory video course before joining. Fiona teaches with a small team that includes Saori Moue and Shivaun Berg, and she also leads workshops abroad. The school keeps a video library for pass holders and shares free counted classes, guided meditations and chanting on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Passes: in-studio and online Mysore classes and video library
courses.description: Monthly, three-month and annual passes, class packs and a video-library subscription covering in-studio and online Mysore classes, the Friday online led class and the school's tutorial library. GST is added at checkout.

courses.title: Introduction to Ashtanga Yoga (online beginner course)
courses.description: A self-paced video course for newcomers: breathing and bandha fundamentals, detailed sun salutations A and B, the standing postures, the three closing postures, a guided practice and a guided deep relaxation. It is the school's recommended starting point before joining Mysore classes.
